rows.label: Axolotl
rows.hook: stays in its larval form for life and can regrow lost limbs

rows.label: Giant panda
rows.hook: is a bamboo-munching black-and-white icon of conservation

rows.label: Giant squid
rows.hook: lurks in the deep sea and inspired the legend of the kraken

rows.label: Squirrel
rows.hook: buries nuts for winter and scampers up trees with a bushy tail

rows.label: Capybara
rows.description: species of large semiaquatic rodent in the cavy family
rows.hook: is the world's largest rodent and is famously calm around other animals

rows.label: Lion
rows.hook: is called the king of the jungle and lives in groups led by a maned male

rows.label: Orca
rows.description: species in the oceanic dolphin family
rows.hook: is a black-and-white apex predator nicknamed the killer whale

rows.label: Tiger
rows.hook: is the largest of the big cats, known for an orange coat with dark stripes

rows.label: Orangutan
rows.description: genus of ape found in rainforests on the Southeast Asian islands of Sumatra and Borneo
rows.hook: is a red-haired ape whose name means person of the forest

rows.label: Komodo dragon
rows.hook: is the heaviest living lizard and roams a few Indonesian islands

rows.label: Cougar
rows.hook: is a big cat also called a mountain lion or puma

rows.label: Jaguar
rows.description: species of big cat native to the Americas
rows.hook: is a powerful spotted big cat of the rainforests that lends its name to a British car maker

rows.label: Polar bear
rows.description: species of bear native largely within the Arctic Circle
rows.hook: is a huge white Arctic predator that hunts seals on sea ice

rows.label: Raccoon
rows.description: species of mammal native to North America
rows.hook: wears a black bandit mask and is famous for raiding trash cans

rows.label: Coyote
rows.hook: is a howling wild dog of North American plains and a classic trickster in folklore

rows.label: Moose
rows.hook: is the largest member of the deer family, with huge flat antlers

rows.label: Platypus
rows.description: semi-aquatic egg-laying mammal endemic to Australia
rows.hook: is an egg-laying oddity with a bill like a duck's

rows.label: Eel
rows.hook: is a long, slippery, snake-shaped swimmer that migrates across oceans to breed

rows.label: Cheetah
rows.hook: is the fastest land animal, sprinting in short bursts

rows.label: Chicken
rows.description: domesticated bird (specifically a red junglefowl) kept by humans primarily as a food source
rows.hook: is the farmyard animal that lays most of the eggs we eat

rows.label: Dodo
rows.description: species of extinct bird native to Mauritius Island
rows.hook: is the famous flightless creature hunted to extinction, a symbol of being long gone

rows.label: Brown bear
rows.hook: includes the grizzly and the Kodiak, among the largest land predators

rows.label: Praying mantis
rows.hook: waits motionless with folded forelegs before snatching prey, and females may eat their mates

rows.label: Leopard
rows.hook: is a stealthy spotted big cat that drags its kills up into trees

rows.label: Red panda
rows.description: species of small mammal from the Ailuridae family, native to Eastern Himalayas and Southwest China
rows.hook: is a rusty-furred tree climber with a ringed bushy tail and a taste for bamboo

rows.label: Hippopotamus
rows.hook: is a huge river-dwelling grazer that spends its days in water and is surprisingly dangerous

rows.label: Cicada
rows.hook: makes a deafening summer buzz after spending years underground

rows.label: Gorilla
rows.hook: is the largest primate, with silverbacks leading family troops and chest-beating displays

rows.label: Great white shark
rows.hook: is the huge ocean predator made famous by a blockbuster film with a scary theme tune

rows.label: Wolf spider
rows.hook: is a hairy hunter that chases down prey instead of trapping it, and carries babies on its back

rows.label: Chimpanzee
rows.description: species of mammal; species of ape
rows.hook: is among our closest living relatives and uses sticks as tools to fish for termites

rows.label: Penguin
rows.description: family of birds in the order Sphenisciformes
rows.hook: is a tuxedo-clad swimmer that cannot fly and waddles across ice

rows.label: Bat
rows.hook: sleeps upside down and navigates in the dark using echolocation

rows.label: Tasmanian devil
rows.description: species of carnivorous marsupial from Australia
rows.hook: is a screeching, ferocious-looking scavenger that inspired a whirling cartoon character

rows.label: Peregrine falcon
rows.hook: is the fastest animal on Earth, reaching enormous speeds in a hunting dive

rows.label: Snow leopard
rows.description: large felid native to the mountains of Central and South Asia
rows.hook: is a rarely seen mountain big cat nicknamed the ghost of the mountains

rows.label: Whale shark
rows.hook: is a gentle, spotted giant of tropical seas that filters plankton and is the largest of its kind

rows.label: Narwhal
rows.description: medium-sized toothed whale that lives year-round in the Arctic
rows.hook: has a long spiral tusk that earned it the nickname unicorn of the sea

rows.label: Hyena
rows.description: family of mammals in the order Carnivora
rows.hook: is a scavenger and hunter of the African savanna with a laugh-like call
